name: Baked Ground Beef & Cheese Flautas with Homemade Salsa

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ jalapeño pepper
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb lean ground beef
chili powder
1 tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the beef is cooking, peel and quarter onion. Peel garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add jalapeño, whole tomatoes, onion, and garlic to the pan. Cook until veggies are just fork-tender, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice half of a lime into a blender. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender along with additional oil and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, drain and add to the blender. Blend on high until salsa is smooth, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.

Fill tortillas with beef and cheese. Roll tightly and place, seam-side down, on the baking sheet, then drizzle with additional oil. Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Transfer flautas to a platter; serve with salsa for dipping and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
